Title: Retirement: transition to the Authentication methods policy for Azure Active Directory

Body.Content: Because the authentication methods policy for Azure Active Directory provides the ability to manage methods for MFA and self-service password reset (SSPR) centrally, we'll retire the ability to manage authentication methods in the legacy MFA and SSPR policies on September 30, 2024. Please migrate to the authentication methods policy using the following documentation.
